## The structure

**Substantive discussion is unified.** Biology, economics, statistics, engineering, and welfare debates happen in **one coherent place** — the [🧠 Substantive discussion hub](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/3) — rather than fragmenting across Workshop / Model / PQ silos. Sub-threads are organized by **domain**, not by origin.

**Process discussion is split by activity** — three separate hubs for three distinct coordination tasks: workshop logistics, PQ framing, and platform/UX.

GitHub Discussions is a flat stack of threads per category; the structure below is maintained by hand and updated as new threads emerge.

## Quick decision tree

| I want to... | Use... |
|---|---|
| Comment on a specific line, paragraph, parameter, or equation | [**Hypothesis**](https://hypothes.is/) — click the `<` tab on the right edge of any dashboard page |
| Debate actual cost values, biology, engineering, welfare, or methodology | [**🧠 Substantive hub (#3)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/3) |
| Discuss how to *frame* a Pivotal Question (resolution, jurisdiction fork, retiring/splitting) | [**🎯 PQ framing hub (#4)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/4) |
| Discuss workshop logistics, scheduling, session format | [**💬 Workshop hub (#2)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/2) |
| Suggest UX, visual, page-layout, or commenting-tool improvements | [**🖥️ Platform & UX hub (#16)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/16) |
| Report a code bug | [**GitHub Issues**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/issues) |

Reading GitHub Discussions is open to everyone; posting requires a free GitHub account.
